audioNote.markdown: The Always Show Tasks setting controls the visibility of tasks, file requests, and forms. When unchecked, only accepted speakers will be able to see these items. If your portal is intended for accepted speakers only, we recommend disabling this setting. Users who are not accepted speakers and assigned to this portal will still see any wiki pages and files assigned.

audioNote.markdown:
When enabled, the email notifications setting sends an email to portal users when tasks, file requests, or forms are assigned within the portal.

Please note: Users will only receive these reminder emails if they have logged into Sessionboard at least once.

To learn more about these and other system-generated emails, view our Automated/System-Generated Emails article.

steps.title: Appearance

audioNote.markdown:
The logo and background will be displayed above the Title. If no logo or background is added here, the portal will default to the images uploaded on your event details page in the Settings module.      



 Please note that the portal background image is narrower than the event background image, so we recommend uploading a new image here that fits the portal’s recommended dimensions.     



You can also add an accent color to align the portal with your event branding for a more customized look.     



Once complete, ensure to select the orange save button at the bottom of the page to ensure all changes are applied to your portal
